note: KlipDot is a well-structured Rust CLI tool for terminal image interception. Strong foundation with production CI/CD (11 workflows, SLSA L2 attestation, multi-OS matrix), solid security posture (TruffleHog, cargo-audit, scorecard, deny.toml), and good developer experience (justfile, pre-commit, CODEOWNERS). Key gaps: sparse testing (no fuzz/proptest/bench, 53 tests for ~6,600 LOC), no structured observability (tracing only with unstructured fmt), deprecated CI actions, missing ARCHITECTURE.md, empty clippy.toml, no CodeQL/SBOM, and an aspirational SPEC.md (2,843 lines) with only 1 of 10 ADRs accepted. No releases yet (v0.1.0). Estimated C+ (65.3%).

items.rationale: Uses Rust 2021 edition with rustfmt.toml configured. Clippy warnings enabled in CI. rust-toolchain.toml pins nightly for fmt.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: clippy.toml exists but is empty (just a comment placeholder). No custom clippy rules or lint-level overrides configured.
items.remediation: Configure clippy.toml with project-specific lint levels: deny unwrap, expect_used, todo, dbg_macro. Add cognitive-complexity threshold.

items.rationale: Uses thiserror for library errors (error.rs) with proper Display/From impls. Well-structured error enum with relevant variants.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: 4 unsafe blocks exist (signal handling in interceptor/main). Each has SAFETY comments but no formal unsafe review or tracking.
items.remediation: Tag each unsafe block with // SAFETY: <justification> referencing an ADR or issue. Add a crate-level unsafe audit marker and CI check.

items.rationale: Production profile uses LTO = 'fat' + strip = 'symbols' in Cargo.toml. Nightly rustfmt for dead-code detection.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: rustfmt.toml with nightly features. CI enforces formatting check in tier0-hygiene.yml. .editorconfig also aligns.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Consistent Rust naming: snake_case for functions/vars, CamelCase for types, SCREAMING_SNAKE for constants. Clippy enforces.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: 14 .rs files in a single crate. Some modules (service.rs, interceptor.rs) may exceed 500 lines. No internal crate splitting.
items.remediation: Consider splitting service.rs and interceptor.rs into submodules if they exceed 600 lines. Evaluate multi-crate workspace for clear boundaries.

items.rationale: No automated duplication detection (no cargo-duplicates, no copypasta check in CI). Duplication may exist across similar error paths.
items.remediation: Add cargo-duplicates or cargo-copypasta to CI. Configure deny threshold.

items.rationale: No cyclomatic complexity or cognitive complexity limits. clippy.toml is empty. No loc-per-function budget.
items.remediation: Set cognitive-complexity threshold (25) in clippy.toml. Add loc-per-function lint (100 lines) and cyclomatic-complexity (35).

items.rationale: No CI check for TODOs or FIXMEs. No tracking or TTL on outstanding work items.
items.remediation: Add CI job to fail on unchecked TODOs. Use RUSTSEC-ignored-equivalent or cargo-todo tool.

items.rationale: CODEOWNERS present with @KooshaPari/core as default reviewer. PR template is 114 lines with detailed checklist.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: CHANGELOG.md exists (56 lines) but is sparse. No automated changelog generation (no cliff.toml or git-cliff). Cargo.toml has 0.1.0.
items.remediation: Add git-cliff or cargo-release for automated changelog generation. Enforce semver via CI check.

items.rationale: Clippy runs in CI (tier0-hygiene.yml) but with 'continue-on-error: true'. Warnings can be merged.
items.remediation: Remove continue-on-error from clippy job. Set RUSTFLAGS='-D warnings' or cargo clippy -- -D warnings in CI.

items.rationale: No ARCHITECTURE.md exists. ADR.md has 10 ADRs but only 1 is accepted. No subsystem diagrams or data-flow docs.
items.remediation: Write ARCHITECTURE.md covering: module boundaries, signal-flow (SIGSTOP/SIGCONT), clipboard lifecycle, image pipeline, and data-flow diagrams (Mermaid).

items.rationale: Well-separated concerns: clipboard.rs, config.rs, interceptor.rs, service.rs, image_processor.rs, image_preview.rs, installer.rs, shell_hooks.rs, stdout_monitor.rs. Single responsibility per module.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Single crate with clear lib.rs exposing public API. main.rs is thin CLI wrapper. Standard Rust project layout.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No formal DI pattern. Modules instantiate their own dependencies. Some tight coupling between interceptor and service.
items.remediation: Introduce trait-based DI for injectable services (clipboard, image processing). Use constructor injection pattern.

items.rationale: Centralized Error enum with proper propagation. Main function handles top-level error with exit codes.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Dedicated config.rs module. CLI args via clap (derive). Clear configuration hierarchy: CLI args → config file → defaults.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Some platform-specific code (signal handling, clipboard) without trait abstraction. 4 unsafe blocks for signal handling assume Unix.
items.remediation: Add cfg(target_os) conditional compilation with fallback implementations for non-Unix platforms. Abstract signal handling behind a trait.

items.rationale: Uses tokio for async runtime. Clear async boundaries: interceptor runs in spawned tasks, service handles streams. Good use of channels.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Proper Drop implementations, signal handling for graceful shutdown (SIGTERM, SIGINT). tempfile usage with scope-based cleanup.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: lib.rs exports public API but no semver visibility analysis. No #[doc(hidden)] markers for internal items. Risk of unintended public API commitments.
items.remediation: Audit public API surface. Add #[doc(hidden)] to internal items. Consider pub(crate) visibility where possible.

items.rationale: No plugin system, no hook system, no trait-based extension points. Single binary with no embedding interface.
items.remediation: If extensibility is desired: define plugin trait, consider WASM plugin host or dylib loading. Otherwise, document as intentionally closed.

items.rationale: Basic use of Result/Option but limited newtype usage for domain primitives (paths, URLs, dimensions are raw types).
items.remediation: Add newtypes for ImagePath, ClipboardFormat, SignalType to leverage Rust's type system for compile-time guarantees.

items.rationale: No formal specification compliance. STDIN/STDOUT interception protocol is ad-hoc. No protocol versioning.
items.remediation: Document the interception protocol in a spec doc. Add protocol version header in intercepted streams.

items.rationale: Global/static state for signal handlers. No explicit state machine for lifecycle states (running, paused, intercepting).
items.remediation: Define explicit AppState enum. Remove global statics in favor of passed state. Implement state transitions with type-state pattern.

items.rationale: Clear separation: lib.rs for library API, main.rs for binary entry point. Library can be consumed by other crates.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No Cargo features defined. Platform-specific code not gated. All functionality compiled in for all targets.
items.remediation: Add Cargo features: default (full), clipboard-x11, clipboard-wayland, image-processing. Gate platform-specific code.

items.rationale: 10 ADRs written (502 lines) but only 1 accepted. 9 remain in 'proposed' or 'draft' state, indicating architectural decisions not ratified.
items.remediation: Schedule ADR review session. Accept/reject each ADR with explicit rationale. Close stalled proposals.

items.rationale: 32 #[test] functions in src/. Coverage not measured (no tarpaulin/grcov in CI). No coverage threshold.
items.remediation: Add tarpaulin or cargo-llvm-cov to CI. Set minimum 60% line coverage gate.

items.rationale: 2 integration test files (tests/smoke_test.rs, plus one more). No E2E scenario tests for the full interception pipeline.
items.remediation: Add integration tests for: full clip → intercept → process → forward flow. Test with mock child processes and signal injection.

items.rationale: 21 #[tokio::test] functions for async modules (interceptor, service, stdout_monitor). Proper use of tokio::test.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Tests follow standard Rust convention: inline #[cfg(test)] modules + tests/ directory. Clear separation of unit and integration.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No proptest or quickcheck usage. Zero property-based tests for any module.
items.remediation: Add proptest dependency. Write property tests for: image format detection, clipboard content validation, shell escaping roundtrips.

items.rationale: No fuzz targets. No cargo-fuzz setup. No OSS-Fuzz integration.
items.remediation: Add cargo-fuzz targets for: image parsing, clipboard input parsing, config file deserialization. Set up CI fuzz run for 30s per target.

items.rationale: No benchmarks (no benches/ directory, no #[bench], no criterion dependency).
items.remediation: Add criterion benchmarks for: image processing latency, clipboard read/write throughput, STDOUT interception overhead.

items.rationale: No regression test directory. No mechanism to capture and replay bug reproducers.
items.remediation: Create test/regression/ directory. For each bug fix, add a regression test first. Document in CONTRIBUTING.md.

items.rationale: No mock framework (mockall, mockito, etc.). Tests use real implementations or ad-hoc stubs. No test doubles for clipboard or image processing.
items.remediation: Add mockall or similar. Create MockClipboard, MockImageProcessor traits. Use in unit tests to isolate interceptor logic.

items.rationale: Some inline test fixtures exist but no dedicated helper crate or test::helpers module for reusable test setup.
items.remediation: Create #[cfg(test)] mod helpers with factory functions for common test objects (test images, mock clipboard contents, sample configs).

items.rationale: grcov + Codecov configured in ci.yml but coverage is generated without blocking. No coverage threshold enforcement.
items.remediation: Set codecov threshold (min 60%). Fail CI if coverage drops below threshold. Add PR comment with coverage diff.

items.rationale: ci.yml has 3 OS × 3 Rust version matrix (stable, beta, nightly) for testing. Comprehensive OS coverage.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No test timeout configuration. Async tests could hang indefinitely if tokio tasks deadlock.
items.remediation: Add #[tokio::test(timeout = 30000)] on all async tests. Set global nextest timeout if migrating to nextest.

items.rationale: No flaky test detection. No retry mechanism. Rerun failures not configured in CI.
items.remediation: Add '--retry 3' for flaky-prone tests. Tag known-flaky tests with #[ignore] or use nextest's flaky detection.

items.rationale: Tests follow descriptive naming: test_<module>_<scenario> pattern. Names clearly indicate what is being tested.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No tests/inputs/ or tests/resources/ directory. Test data is inline or generated at runtime.
items.remediation: Create tests/resources/ for test images, sample clipboard data, config files. Generate reference checksums for validation.

items.rationale: No doctests in API documentation. Most public functions lack examples that compile as tests.
items.remediation: Add /// ``` examples to all public API functions. Run doctests in CI (cargo test --doc). Ensure examples are runnable.

items.rationale: Some error paths tested but coverage of error conditions is uneven. No error injection framework for testing failure modes.
items.remediation: Add systematic error-path tests: IO errors, permission denied, broken pipe, malformed images. Use fault injection via mock layer.

items.rationale: Some edge cases tested (empty clipboard, large images) but not systematically. No null-byte or unicode boundary tests.
items.remediation: Add targeted edge-case tests: zero-byte images, unicode filenames, long paths (>4k chars), buffer overflow attempts.

items.rationale: Tests that touch clipboard/image processing have side effects. Temporary files use tempfile crate. No full sandboxing.
items.remediation: Use tempdir/tempfile for all filesystem operations in tests. Add capability to run clipboard tests in a mock environment.

items.rationale: Tests use #[serial_test::serial] on some shared-resource tests. Not all shared-state tests are annotated.
items.remediation: Audit all tests for shared state (clipboard, filesystem, signals). Add #[serial_test::serial] where needed. Document test isolation requirements.

items.rationale: Tests use default cargo test runner. No nextest configuration (no .config/nextest.toml).
items.remediation: Add cargo-nextest to CI. Configure nextest.toml with per-file timeouts, retries, and test partitioning.

items.rationale: No JUnit/XML test report generation. No test history tracking. No trend visualization.
items.remediation: Add --log-junit or nextest --message-format junit for CI artifact generation. Publish test reports as CI artifacts.

items.rationale: Uneven test distribution: some modules have 5+ tests, others 0-1. No minimum test-per-module policy.
items.remediation: Audit test coverage per module. Aim for minimum 2 tests per module. Create tracking issue for under-tested modules.

items.rationale: tests/smoke_test.rs provides basic smoke test for CLI startup and basic functionality.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: continue-on-error: true set on test jobs. Failing tests do not block PR merge. No test pass requirement in quality gate.
items.remediation: Remove continue-on-error from test jobs. Set test pass as a hard gate in quality-gate.yml. Deploy a 'ci required' branch protection rule.

items.rationale: tracing-subscriber uses fmt() subscriber only. No structured JSON output format. Logs are human-readable only.
items.remediation: Add tracing-subscriber JSON format. Conditionally select fmt vs JSON based on LOG_FORMAT env var or CLI flag.

items.rationale: Consistent use of tracing levels (error, warn, info, debug, trace). RUST_LOG environment variable controls verbosity.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No OpenTelemetry integration. No tracing propagation. No trace context across process boundaries.
items.remediation: Add opentelemetry-otlp crate. Configure OTLP exporter for span export. Add traceparent header propagation for intercepted subprocesses.

items.rationale: No metrics system. No counters for images processed, bytes transferred, latency, error rates.
items.remediation: Add metrics crate (or use tracing-metrics). Expose counters for: images_intercepted, bytes_processed, errors_by_type, operation_latency.

items.rationale: Logs to stderr by default (tracing convention) but interception mode may interfere with logging. No separate log file option.
items.remediation: Add --log-file CLI flag for file output. Ensure logging never writes to stdout (intercepted stream). Add log rotation.

items.rationale: No error aggregation. No error-rate computation. No alert threshold mechanism.
items.remediation: Add in-memory error counter with sliding window. Emit error-rate metric. Consider integration with health endpoint.

items.rationale: No health check endpoint. No HTTP server for status queries. Process liveness only via PID.
items.remediation: Add optional HTTP health endpoint (--health-addr 127.0.0.1:9091). Serve /healthz (liveness) and /readyz (readiness).

items.rationale: Signal handlers log shutdown events but no structured shutdown sequence logging. Not clear which resources are cleaned up.
items.remediation: Add structured shutdown phases: 'waiting for child', 'flushing clipboard', 'cleaning temp files'. Log each with duration.

items.rationale: No debug dump feature for support incidents. No --dump-state or --debug CLI flag for verbose introspection.
items.remediation: Add --dump-state CLI flag. On SIGUSR1, dump internal state (active sessions, pending images, config) to a temp file.

items.rationale: No explicit latency histograms. No p50/p95/p99 tracking for interception, image processing, clipboard ops.
items.remediation: Add tracing spans with duration tracking. Record latency percentiles in metrics. Log slow operations (>500ms) at WARN level.

items.rationale: No trace ID propagation across async boundaries. Spans are not connected through task lifecycle.
items.remediation: Use TracingContext or tokio-rs/tracing instrumentation for async spans. Ensure trace_id flows through spawned tasks and child processes.

items.rationale: Some spans have fields but not systematically. Many log events lack context (operation_id, image_type, pid).
items.remediation: Systematically add span fields: operation.id, image.format, image.size_bytes, child.pid, duration_ms. Use structured fields over formatted strings.

items.rationale: No audit log for operations. No record of which images were intercepted, processed, or forwarded.
items.remediation: Add optional audit log file. Record: timestamp, operation, image_checksum, size, source_pid. Off by default, opt-in via --audit-log.

items.rationale: No panic hook for structured panic reporting. Panics print default Rust panic message to stderr.
items.remediation: Install custom panic hook that logs via tracing::error! with structured fields. Include backtrace and version.

items.rationale: Uses tracing facade which provides vendor-neutral instrumentation. Can be switched between fmt, JSON, OTLP without code changes.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: RUST_LOG env var configures log level. No structured config for observability (log format, output destination, sampling rate).
items.remediation: Add OBSERVABILITY section to CLI args/config file: log-format (auto/json/fmt), log-file, metrics-addr, tracing-sample-rate.

items.rationale: Third-party dependencies using log crate emit to stderr. No bridge from log to tracing. Mixed log/tracing output.
items.remediation: Add tracing-log feature to capture log crate events. Use tracing-subscriber's LogTracer layer to bridge log→tracing.

items.rationale: Events use ad-hoc message strings. No structured event taxonomy (event names, event IDs, severity levels beyond tracing levels).
items.remediation: Define event taxonomy document: event namespaces (klipdot.interceptor.*, klipdot.clipboard.*), event IDs, required fields per event type.

items.rationale: Clippy runs in CI. TruffleHog scans for secrets. cargo-audit runs weekly for dependency vulnerabilities.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No dynamic analysis. No runtime security testing (no cargo-fuzz, no AFL, no honggfuzz runtime).
items.remediation: Set up cargo-fuzz targets for image parsing and clipboard processing. Add AFL-based fuzz harness for binary parsing.

items.rationale: No SBOM generation. No CycloneDX or SPDX output. No dependency bill-of-materials artifact.
items.remediation: Add cargo-cyclonedx or cargo-audit --json SBOM generation to CI. Publish SBOM as release artifact.

items.rationale: cargo-audit runs weekly in CI (cargo-deny.yml). GitHub Dependabot not configured but cargo-audit covers Rust advisory DB.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: TruffleHog workflow runs in CI. Scans for accidentally committed secrets. Pre-commit hooks also may catch secrets.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No code signing for binaries. GitHub release attestation (SLSA L2) provides provenance but no binary signing.
items.remediation: Add GPG or Sigstore signing for release binaries. Configure cosign for container images.

items.rationale: Cargo.lock is committed (pins exact versions). Git dependency on clap-ext (unpinned, may drift). deny.toml has allow/warn/deny rules.
items.remediation: Pin git dep to specific commit SHA. Add cargo-deny CI check for unverified git dependencies.

items.rationale: 4 unsafe blocks with // SAFETY comments but no formal review checklist. No 'unsafe audit' tracking issue or document.
items.remediation: Create UNSAFE.md tracking all unsafe blocks with review status. Run safety checks in CI: miri test on modules containing unsafe.

items.rationale: Signal handlers use unsafe for sigaction. Async-signal-safety not fully verified. No signal-safety audit document.
items.remediation: Audit signal handlers for async-signal-safety. Move unsafe signal logic to a signal-safe module with formal review. Consider using signal-hook crate.

items.rationale: CLI input validated via clap derive. Image and clipboard input validated during processing. No centralized input validation layer.
items.remediation: Create centralized InputValidator module. Apply validation at all entry points (CLI, config file, pipe input, clipboard data).

items.rationale: No explicit path traversal checks on input filenames or paths from clipboard/content. Relies on OS-level restrictions.
items.remediation: Add directory traversal detection for all file operations. Reject paths containing '..', null bytes, or absolute paths when relative expected.

items.rationale: Uses tempfile crate for temporary files. Temp files are created with restricted permissions and cleaned up on drop.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Shell hooks use proper escaping. No string interpolation of user input into shell commands. Uses Command::new() not shell execution.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: deny.toml configured with bans, advisories, licenses, sources sections. CI runs cargo-deny weekly.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: deny.toml has license configuration. Copyleft licenses properly managed. LICENSE files present.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: scorecard.yml workflow in CI. OpenSSF Scorecard runs automatically.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: All CI workflows pin actions to full-length commit SHAs (verified: actions/*@sha256...). No 'master'/'main' tag references.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: cargo-audit runs weekly via cargo-deny.yml. Scheduled CI trigger ensures regular dependency scanning.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: release-attestation.yml generates SLSA L2 provenance attestations for release artifacts.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: SECURITY.md present with vulnerability disclosure policy. References where to report issues.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: SECURITY.md has contact information. CODEOWNERS has @KooshaPari/core for security-sensitive files.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: cargo-audit uses RustSec advisory DB. Weekly scans detect known vulnerabilities in dependency tree.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No cargo-crev setup. No code review trust network. No dependency review attestations.
items.remediation: Consider cargo-crev for dependency trust verification. Add to CI if adopting.

items.rationale: No CodeQL workflow. No GitHub CodeQL query suite for Rust security analysis.
items.remediation: Add codeql.yml workflow analyzing Rust sources. Configure security-extended query suite.

items.rationale: No Miri test runs. Unsafe code not checked experimentally for UB.
items.remediation: Add cargo miri test to CI for modules containing unsafe. Run weekly as part of security workflow.

items.rationale: Temp files use secure defaults. No explicit umask setting. Config file permissions not enforced.
items.remediation: Set restrictive umask (0077) during startup. Verify config file permissions (owner-only read/write).

items.rationale: Subprocess execution uses Command API (no shell expansion). STDIN/STDOUT pipes controlled. No argument injection surface.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: File operations may be subject to TOCTOU in temp directory. No exclusive file locking for concurrent access.
items.remediation: Add advisory file locking for shared resources. Use O_CREAT|O_EXCL for atomic file creation where applicable.

items.rationale: Error messages (thiserror) are user-facing safe. No path leaks in user-facing errors. File paths redacted in user output.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Environment variables read for config (RUST_LOG, etc.) but no validation. No env-var allowlist or size limits.
items.remediation: Add maximum size limits for env var values. Validate env vars at startup. Document all recognized env vars in SECURITY.md.

items.rationale: Clipboard content copied to temp files. No explicit clearing of clipboard buffers from memory after use.
items.remediation: Zeroize clipboard buffers after processing with zeroize crate. Use mlock to prevent sensitive data from being swapped.

items.rationale: No dedicated security regression tests. Previous CVEs or security issues not captured as test cases.
items.remediation: Create tests/security/ directory. Add regression tests for each security fix. Document security test scenarios.

items.rationale: No ARCHITECTURE.md. Module structure not documented at project level. No diagrams or data-flow documentation.
items.remediation: Create ARCHITECTURE.md with: module directory, ASCII/Mermaid diagrams for interception pipeline, data flow, component responsibilities.

items.rationale: Some public API items have doc comments. Many modules lack docstrings on functions and types. No #[warn(missing_docs)].
items.remediation: Enable #[warn(missing_docs)] in lib.rs. Add docstrings to all public API items. Document panics, errors, examples in API docs.

items.rationale: README.md present with build instructions, usage examples, and feature description. Standard Rust project README.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md present (25 lines). Covers basic contribution workflow.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: CHANGELOG.md exists (56 lines) but is sparse with only broad entries. Not following Keep a Changelog format. Manual updates.
items.remediation: Reformat CHANGELOG.md per Keep a Changelog standard. Add git-cliff for automated generation. Add version links.

items.rationale: ADR.md has 10 ADRs (502 lines) but only 1 accepted. No docs/adr/ directory with individual ADR files. Cross-references from ADR.md may be broken.
items.remediation: Create docs/adr/ directory. Split each ADR into its own file. Accept/reject all pending ADRs. Fix broken cross-references.

items.rationale: SPEC.md exists (2,843 lines) but is aspirational. Much of the spec describes planned features not yet implemented. Risks confusion.
items.remediation: Tag unimplemented sections with '(planned)' or '(future)'. Consider splitting into SPEC.md (implemented) and ROADMAP.md (planned).

items.rationale: PRD.md present with product requirements. Good for aligning development with product goals.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: PLAN.md present. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for AI-agent context. SSOT.md present for single-source-of-truth references.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: docs/ directory exists but contains stubs only. Not organized (no docs/security/, docs/architecture/, docs/ops/ subdirectories).
items.remediation: Organize docs/ with subdirectories: architecture/, security/, ops/, guides/, reference/. Move stubs to appropriate locations.

items.rationale: llms.txt is referenced in AGENTS.md but file is missing. No LLM-context file for AI coding assistants.
items.remediation: Create llms.txt with: project summary, architecture overview, build commands, test commands, key patterns, CI/CD info.

items.rationale: SECURITY.md present with disclosure policy. deny.toml documents dependency policies.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: README has basic usage examples. No dedicated examples/ directory with runnable example programs. No tutorial docs.
items.remediation: Create examples/ with: basic-intercept.rs, custom-config.rs, shell-hooks-example.rs. Add tutorials for common workflows.

items.rationale: Some modules have good comments (interceptor: signal handling). Others lack inline documentation (service.rs, image_processor.rs).
items.remediation: Add inline comments for non-obvious logic. Document why (not what) in comments. Focus on complex async flows and unsafe blocks.

items.rationale: Config options documented in CLI help text (clap derive generates --help). README covers basic configuration.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No release notes. No per-version changelog section. GitHub Releases not created yet (no releases).
items.remediation: Create first GitHub Release (v0.1.0) with release notes. Automate via git-cliff CHANGELOG → release workflow.

items.rationale: No troubleshooting or FAQ document. Common issues and solutions not documented.
items.remediation: Create TROUBLESHOOTING.md covering: installation issues, clipboard problems, signal conflicts, Docker usage, known limitations.

items.rationale: ci.yml runs on ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest. Full cross-platform coverage.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: CI runs against stable, beta, and nightly Rust channels. Early detection of regressions across toolchains.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No CI caching (cargo, target directory). No incremental compilation. No test partitioning. Full rebuild each run.
items.remediation: Add Swatinem/rust-cache action. Configure sccache or cargo-cache. Partition tests with nextest.

items.rationale: No timeout-minutes set on any ci.yml job. Default 360 minutes could waste CI minutes on hung jobs.
items.remediation: Set timeout-minutes: 30 for test jobs, 60 for build jobs, 10 for lint jobs.

items.rationale: continue-on-error: true set on nearly all jobs in ci.yml. No hard quality gates. CI always passes regardless of failures.
items.remediation: Remove continue-on-error from critical jobs (test, build, clippy). Keep on experimental (nightly, benchmark) only.

items.rationale: Uses deprecated actions: actions-rs/toolchain (migrated to dtolnay/rust-toolchain), actions/create-release (migrated to softprops/action-gh-release).
items.remediation: Migrate actions-rs/toolchain → dtolnay/rust-toolchain. Migrate actions/create-release → softprops/action-gh-release. Run action updater regularly.

items.rationale: Build artifacts (5 targets) uploaded with explicit retention periods. Release artifacts have provenance attestations.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No quality-gate.yml enforcement. No branch protection rules requiring CI pass before merge.
items.remediation: Create required status checks in GitHub branch protection. quality-gate.yml should block PR merge on test/clippy/build failure.

items.rationale: 11 CI workflows covering: main CI, release, release-attestation, cargo-deny, tier0-hygiene, scorecard, trufflehog, quality-gate, and more. Comprehensive coverage.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Some duplicated workflow logic across ci.yml and release.yml. No reusable workflow composition (no workflow_call).
items.remediation: Extract shared steps (test, build, lint) into reusable workflows with workflow_call triggers. Reduce duplication.

items.rationale: No CI failure notifications. No Slack/Discord/email integration for broken builds.
items.remediation: Add workflow failure notification via GitHub Actions (slack-github-action, discord-webhook, or email).

items.rationale: No concurrency groups in CI workflows. Multiple pushes to same branch can run overlapping workflows wasting CI minutes.
items.remediation: Add concurrency group per branch with cancel-in-progress: true to all CI workflows.

items.rationale: No checksum verification for cached dependencies. Cache poisoning risk not addressed.
items.remediation: Add cache checksum verification. Use Cargo.lock hash as cache key. Periodically invalidate cache.

items.rationale: No actionlint or similar workflow validation. Workflow syntax errors not caught before push.
items.remediation: Add actionlint to pre-commit or tier0-hygiene CI workflow. Validate all .github/workflows/*.yml.

items.rationale: Cargo.lock committed to repository for reproducible builds. Git dep on clap-ext pinned (but to branch not commit).
items.remediation: Pin clap-ext git dep to specific commit SHA, not branch name.

items.rationale: No Cargo.lock freshness check in CI. No validate for outdated or stale lock files.
items.remediation: Add CI job checking Cargo.lock is up to date (cargo check --locked). Fail on stale lock.

items.rationale: cargo-audit integrates with RustSec advisory DB. Weekly CI scan.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: cargo-deny.yml runs weekly on schedule. TruffleHog also scans for committed secrets.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: deny.toml has license configuration with allow/deny list. cargo-deny enforces license policy in CI.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: clap-ext is a git dependency (not crates.io or vendored). Git deps are mutable by nature. No policy on acceptable git deps.
items.remediation: Document git dep policy in CONTRIBUTING.md. Consider vendoring clap-ext or publishing to crates.io if stable.

items.rationale: No cargo-udeps or cargo-deny 'unused' check. Unused dependencies may be present in Cargo.toml.
items.remediation: Add cargo-udeps to CI (nightly). Remove unused dependencies. Configure cargo-deny to warn on unused.

items.rationale: Cargo.lock pins exact versions. deny.toml configured for version bans/sources.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: cargo-audit detects yanked crate versions. Weekly CI scan alerts on yanked dependencies.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No dependency diff generated on Cargo.lock changes. PRs with dep changes not flagged for supply chain review.
items.remediation: Add action to comment on PRs with dependency diff when Cargo.lock changes. Flag for maintainer review.

items.rationale: No SBOM artifact in releases or CI. No CycloneDX or SPDX output.
items.remediation: Add cargo-cyclonedx to release workflow. Publish SBOM alongside release artifacts.

items.rationale: Dependencies not vendored. Standard crates.io resolution. No vendoring policy documented.
items.remediation: Document vendoring policy in CONTRIBUTING.md. Consider cargo vendor for air-gapped builds if needed.

items.rationale: SLSA L2 attestations generated in release-attestation.yml. Build provenance chains established.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No checksum file generated for release binaries. Users cannot verify binary integrity after download.
items.remediation: Generate SHA-256 checksums for all release artifacts. Publish checksums as release asset. Consider GPG signing.

items.rationale: No Dependabot or Renovate configuration. Dependency updates are manual. No automated update PRs.
items.remediation: Add Dependabot config for Cargo and GitHub Actions. Set weekly schedule. Add auto-merge for patch updates.

items.rationale: Dockerfile present but no cosign or container signing. No container image attestation.
items.remediation: Add cosign to container build step. Sign images with keyless (OIDC) signing via GitHub OIDC. Attest with SLSA.

items.rationale: No crate publishing token rotation policy. No CI checks for crate metadata correctness.
items.remediation: Add cargo publish dry-run in CI. Document crate publishing credentials in SECURITY.md.

items.rationale: No policy on maximum dependency age. Outdated deps may accumulate without notice.
items.remediation: Add cargo-outdated or cargo-limit to CI. Alert on deps more than 6 months behind latest.

items.rationale: Uses default crates.io registry with cargo-deny source configuration. deny.toml controls registry sources.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: Cargo.lock pinned. cargo-deny configured with source replacement checks. No [patch] section in Cargo.toml (no subversion risk).
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: release.yml (295 lines) fully automates: tag-driven release, crates.io publish, Homebrew formula, AUR package, Docker image.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No cargo-release or automate version bumping. Version is manual in Cargo.toml. No version consistency checks.
items.remediation: Add cargo-release or release-plz for automated version bumping and publishing. Validate crate version vs tag.

items.rationale: CHANGELOG.md manually maintained and sparse. No automated changelog generation from commits.
items.remediation: Integrate git-cliff into release workflow. Auto-generate changelog from conventional commits.

items.rationale: No GPG or Sigstore signing of release artifacts. SLSA L2 provides provenance but not artifact signing.
items.remediation: Add GPG signing of release artifacts or cosign keyless signing. Publish signing public key.

items.rationale: No automated release notes. GitHub Releases not yet created. First release pending.
items.remediation: Auto-generate release notes from git-cliff or GitHub releases. Include changelog, known issues, upgrade guide.

items.rationale: Cargo.toml version 0.1.0 (pre-1.0). SEMVER implied but not enforced. No major/minor/patch labeling of PRs.
items.remediation: Add semantic PR labels. Integrate cargo-semver-checks to detect semver violations in public API.

items.rationale: No dry-run release step before actual release. No release preview or validation.
items.remediation: Add release dry-run to CI: cargo publish --dry-run, verify all targets build, validate CHANGELOG.

items.rationale: Multi-channel: crates.io, Homebrew, AUR, Docker. Good coverage for Rust ecosystem and package managers.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: crates.io: yank is possible. Homebrew: revert formula. Docker: tag-based rollback. AUR: version rollback. No automated rollback playbook.
items.remediation: Document rollback procedures for each distribution channel. Test rollback process.

items.rationale: Tag-driven release workflow using v* format (semver). Tags trigger release.yml pipeline.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No pre-release (alpha/beta/rc) channel support. No canary or nightly release mechanism.
items.remediation: Add pre-release workflow: publish to test-pypi equivalent, create GitHub Pre-release, tag candidates.

items.rationale: release-attestation.yml generates SLSA L2 provenance. Good supply-chain security for release artifacts.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: 5 build targets across platforms. Docker image. Homebrew formula. AUR package. Comprehensive release asset catalog.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: 8 pre-commit hooks configured in .pre-commit-config.yaml: formatting, linting, whitespace, merge-conflict detection.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No lefthook.yml. Pre-commit is Python-native. Lefthook would provide faster, parallel hook execution.
items.remediation: Add lefthook.yml equivalent to pre-commit hooks. Lefthook is faster (parallel) and Rust-native.

items.rationale: No .devcontainer directory. No VSCode dev container config for instant development environment.
items.remediation: Add .devcontainer/devcontainer.json with Rust toolchain, clippy, rustfmt, pre-commit, and recommended extensions.

items.rationale: justfile present with common commands: build, test, lint, format, coverage. Good task runner for common workflows.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md (114 lines) with detailed checklist: testing, documentation, changelog, migration, breaking changes.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: 4 issue templates covering: bug report, feature request, question, security. Structured forms for consistent reporting.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md present. CODEOWNERS present. FUNDING.yml for sponsorship.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md provide context for AI coding assistants. llms.txt referenced but missing.
items.remediation: Create llms.txt per referenced expectations.

items.rationale: .editorconfig, .gitattributes, rustfmt.toml all present. Consistent across editors.
items.remediation: None required.

items.rationale: No CI-level caching configured. Local builds use incremental compilation (default). No sccache or cargo-cache.
items.remediation: Add cargo-cache to justfile. Document sccache setup for large Rust monorepos. Add CI caching.

items.rationale: justfile covers main operations. No scripts/ directory for helper scripts (coverage, benchmark, setup).
items.remediation: Create scripts/ with: setup-dev.sh, run-coverage.sh, run-benchmarks.sh, update-deps.sh.

items.rationale: Uses default cargo test. Nextest not configured. Slower test execution, no partitioning.
items.remediation: Add cargo-nextest to dev dependencies. Create .config/nextest.toml with profiles. Add to justfile.

items.rationale: README has basic build/run instructions. No dedicated GETTING_STARTED.md. No step-by-step onboarding.
items.remediation: Create GETTING_STARTED.md with: prerequisites, install via each channel, first interception, configuration, troubleshooting.

strengths: Production CI/CD with 11 workflows across 3 OS × 3 Rust versions — multi-OS matrix, build (5 targets), Docker, coverage
SLSA L2 provenance attestation in release pipeline — industry-leading supply-chain security for a pre-1.0 project
Comprehensive security scanning: TruffleHog, cargo-audit, cargo-deny, OpenSSF Scorecard — all running on schedule
Well-modularized Rust architecture with clear separation of concerns (14 dedicated modules for specific functions)
Pre-commit hooks (8 checks), detailed PR template (114 lines), and comprehensive issue templates (4) — strong DX foundation
Multi-channel distribution strategy: crates.io, Homebrew, AUR, Docker — set up before first release
Error handling excellence: thiserror Error enum, proper propagation, safe user-facing messages
weaknesses: Testing deficit: 53 tests for ~6,600 LOC (1 test per ~125 LOC). No fuzz, proptest, benchmarks, or nextest runner
continue-on-error: true on all CI jobs — CI pipeline reports success even when tests/lint fail, no hard quality gates
Deprecated CI actions (actions-rs/toolchain, actions/create-release) — possible breakage on runner updates
No structured observability — tracing only emits unstructured human-readable logs, no JSON/OTel/metrics
Empty clippy.toml — no custom lint levels, no complexity limits, no code quality guardrails despite Rust's strong lint system
Documentation gaps: ARCHITECTURE.md missing, docs/ directory has stubs only, ADRs mostly unaccepted (1/10)
First release still pending (v0.1.0) — distribution channels configured but not battle-tested
critical_gaps: No hard CI quality gates (continue-on-error on all jobs makes CI near-useless as a quality barrier)
No structured observability (can't debug production issues without JSON logs, metrics, or tracing context)
No fuzz testing (image parsing and clipboard processing accept potentially untrusted input)
No dependabot/renovate (dependency updates are manual with no automated review)
No CodeQL or Miri (unsafe code in signal handling not independently verified for UB)
top_5_priorities: 1. Remove continue-on-error from critical CI jobs and add branch protection rules
2. Add structured observability (JSON logging, metrics, health endpoint)
3. Set up fuzz testing for image parsing and clipboard input
4. Create ARCHITECTURE.md and fix ADR acceptance process
5. Add cargo-nextest, proptest, and benchmark targets

phase_0.title: Quick Wins — Low Effort, High Impact (~2h)

items.action: Remove continue-on-error from test, build, and clippy jobs in ci.yml. Keep on nightly/benchmark.
items.rationale: Immediately makes CI a meaningful quality gate. Prevents broken code from merging.

items.action: Migrate actions-rs/toolchain → dtolnay/rust-toolchain in all workflows.
items.rationale: Removes dependency on deprecated action that could break at any time.

items.action: Add codeql.yml workflow with security-extended query suite.
items.rationale: GitHub-native static analysis. No external deps. Catches common Rust security issues.

items.action: Add .github/dependabot.yml for Cargo and GitHub Actions weekly updates.
items.rationale: Automated dependency update PRs. Prevents dependency drift and missed security patches.

items.action: Create llms.txt with project summary, build commands, and architecture for AI coding assistants.
items.rationale: Referenced in AGENTS.md but missing. Quick win for AI-assisted development workflow.

items.action: Set clippy to deny warnings in CI tier0-hygiene.yml (remove continue-on-error, add -D warnings).
items.rationale: Enforces Rust best practices. Early detection of code quality regressions.

items.action: Set up GitHub branch protection rules requiring CI status checks. Create quality-gate.yml that enforces test/build/clippy pass.
items.rationale: Prevents merging breaking changes. Hardens repository against accidental bad merges.

items.action: Add structured JSON logging (tracing-subscriber JSON), basic metrics counters, and optional health endpoint.
items.rationale: Minimal viable observability. JSON logging enables log aggregation. Metrics enable monitoring.

items.action: Add proptest for image format detection. Set up cargo-fuzz with 3 targets (image, clipboard, config). Add criterion benchmark for image processing latency.
items.rationale: Catches edge cases and input-handling bugs. Performance baseline for optimization. Essential for CLI tool processing untrusted input.

items.action: Write ARCHITECTURE.md (module boundaries, data flow, interception pipeline diagram). Split ADR.md into docs/adr/ individual files. Accept/reject all pending ADRs.
items.remediation: Foundational documentation for contributor onboarding and architectural decision tracking.

items.action: Configure clippy.toml with cognitive-complexity limit (25), loc-per-function (100), cyclomatic-complexity (35). Add cargo-udeps to CI.
items.remediation: Enforces code quality guardrails. Prevents excessive complexity before code review.

items.action: Add SHA-256 checksum generation for release artifacts. Sign Docker images with cosign keyless signing.
items.remediation: Release integrity verification for users. Prevents supply-chain attacks on binary distribution.

items.action: Add cargo-nextest configuration with per-file timeouts. Set up coverage threshold enforcement (min 60%). Add test reporting artifacts.
items.remediation: Faster test execution, better failure diagnostics, coverage visibility.

items.action: Integrate OpenTelemetry tracing with OTLP export. Add trace context propagation across async boundaries and subprocess spawns. Enrich span fields with operation context.
items.remediation: Production-grade distributed tracing for debugging complex interception flows.

items.action: Create UNSAFE.md tracking all 4 unsafe blocks with review evidence. Add cargo miri test in CI for modules containing unsafe. Set up GPG/cosign signing for release binaries.
items.remediation: Unsafe code accountability, UB detection, and binary authenticity verification.

items.action: Add Cargo feature gates (clipboard-x11, clipboard-wayland, image-processing, signal-unix). Abstract signal handling behind platform trait. Introduce trait-based DI for injectable services.
items.remediation: Platform portability, compile-time feature selection, and testability via dependency injection.
